label: Housing subscription savings deduction: annual cap for a qualifying foreign employee
unit: KRW annual contribution eligible for deduction
appliesTo: Foreign residents who are the spouse of a head of household owning no home, with total salary of ₩70m or below
why: The narrowest of the housing exceptions and the newest, opened on contributions from 2025. It matters because the blanket statement it replaces — that a foreign national simply cannot claim housing subscription savings — is still the general rule for most people, so only the exception moved. Recording both states keeps that distinction visible.

history.note: A foreign national cannot be a head of household in the ordinary sense under the resident registration system, so the deduction was effectively closed.

history.source: National Tax Service — 2026 year-end settlement guidance for foreign employees
history.note: From contributions made in 2025: a foreign resident with total salary of ₩70,000,000 or below who is the spouse of a head of household owning no home, contributing to a qualifying housing savings account in their own name, may deduct 40% of contributions up to ₩3,000,000 a year. The general position for other foreign nationals is unchanged.
